question: Can Figure2B Sirius red graph values reproduce the genotype-specific normalization in Figure2C, and are the documented experimental units sufficient for a regression contrast?
data_role: Publication source-data reproducibility check; not an independent prediction dataset.
system: Male mouse liver; HSC-specific Ets1 deletion versus floxed control; CCl4 injury6weeks then cessation2weeks; terminal histological groups, not paired trajectories.
measurement: Sirius red positive area (% tissue area); C dimensionless fraction relative to genotype-specific injury-group mean. Not collagen mass.
selection: Figure2B/C first four columns only, chosen as the direct collagen-related injury/cessation comparison. No searching other endpoints for favorable effects.
prior_visibility: The article conclusion was known. A metadata read unintentionally displayed the first six numerical rows of Figures2B/C and excerpts2D/E before this specification. Therefore exploratory; not outcome-blinded/preregistered. No numeric program or hypothesis test has run.
normalization: For each genotype divide every B value (both injury and regression) by that genotype injury arithmetic mean. Compare sorted arrays to C: row order does not identify animals.

expected_n.analysis: Use actual nonblank source counts; do not invent or drop a seventh mouse.

tolerance_reason: 5e-6 permits rounding of six-decimal normalized values;0.002 is a deliberately loose sensitivity bound for rounding of hundredth-percent absolute input, not biological accuracy.
acceptance: All four group counts equal and every sorted normalized discrepancy <=5e-6 for strict reproduction; report0.002 sensitivity separately. Sample-size disagreement remains an unresolved provenance issue.
stop_rule: If normalization fails either group or sample-unit provenance unresolved, report descriptive means and normalized fractions but withhold inferential p-values, mechanistic calibration, effect prioritization and a reproduction-pass claim. Do not repair source values.
descriptives: n,mean,SD, recovered/injured group-mean ratio for each genotype, ratio-of-ratios KO/control; calculate separately from B-derived and supplied C. No pairing.
uncertainty: Normalization mismatch and missing animal identifiers are source/provenance uncertainty; no bootstrap will conceal it.
